about: Next releases a publisher has stated, keyed by the ref of the survey file now on the Farmland Atlas (the source.ref in data/land/<state>/*.json). scripts/land_sources.py reads it; a source not listed here prints 'not announced'. Add a date only from the publisher's own announcement, never a guess; when the survey file is replaced (a new ref), its old entry stops matching on its own.
